description: Day 22 control set: 10 questions over rag/corpus. category: specific (answer lives in a concrete corpus passage; a plain LLM is expected to be generic/different), common (plain LLM likely fine), out_of_corpus (corpus has no answer; the right behaviour is to admit it). mustContain = groups of alternatives; a group is hit when ANY alternative occurs (case-insensitive) in the answer; the answer should hit every group. expectedSources = source file + heading keyword of the section that holds the answer.
